tests.title: Case 1 - Verify that rotation is enabled in Macromolecules mode when two monomers without any bonds between them are selected
Case 2 - Verify that rotation is enabled in Macromolecules mode when two monomers with bonds between them are selected
Case 3 - Verify that rotation is enabled in Macromolecules mode when more than two monomers are selected, regardless of whether they are connected by bonds
Case 4 - Verify that rotation is not enabled in Macromolecules mode when only one monomer is selected
Case 5 - Verify that a bounding box with a rotaition handle and a cross in the center of rotation appears when two or more monomers are selected in Macromolecules mode
Case 6 - Verify that there are rotation, flip, delete buttons above the bounding box for selected monomers in Macromolecules mode
Case 7 - Verify that in Macromolecules mode rotation angles are displayed near the bounding box while rotating
Case 8 - Verify that the default rotation angle is set to 15° in Macromolecules mode

Case 9 - Verify that rotation mode gets activated in Macromolecules mode by pressing the left mouse button (a rotation handle turns blue, a cross turns blue, and a blue dashed line connectes them, the bounding box is replaced with a circle)

Case 10 - Verify that when rotation mode is deactivated in Macromolecules mode, the selected fragment remains in its new position, rotation circle is replaced with the bounding box, that is redrawn at its initial position, and all labels of the rotated fragment are aligned with horizontal axis
Case 11 - Verify that 'flip horizontally', 'flip vertically' and 'delete' buttons work as expected in Macromolecule mode
Case 12 - Verify that when rotation mode is activated, the center of the circle is at the center of rotation, the circle's diameter is equal to the height of the replaced bounding box
Case 13 - Verify that when rotation mode is activated in Macromolecule mode the following predefined angles is marked on the rotation circle: -90, -60, -45, -30, 0, 30, 45, 60, 90
Case 14 - Verify that when rotation starts in Macromolecule mode, the set of angles shown always covers the range [-90 - +90] relatively to the handle position
Case 15 - Verify that when rotation starts in Macromolecule mode, the current rotation angle is displayed at starting position
Case 16 - Verify ability to move the center of rotation in Macromolecules mode
